node.statement: Fix an arbitrary witness tuple W and arbitrary displayed algebra/data satisfying the hypotheses. By positivity of every entry in the defining minimum, epsilon_*^r>0. Invoke lem-stage1-quotient-manifold-package and let e_quot^r>0 be its universal constant; set epsilon_B^r:=min{epsilon_*^r,e_quot^r}>0. Since epsilon_r<=epsilon_B^r<=e_quot^r and 1<dim_C calX<infinity, that external gives breve-calU:=calU_e/U(1) as a connected compact orientable smooth manifold without boundary of real dimension dim_C(calX)-1.
